guild.bad_timezone: That time zone is not in the IANA database.
guild.citadel_protected: The Citadel cannot be excluded or removed: pass the Citadel to another machine first.
guild.confirm_required: Read the warning of the removal and confirm.
guild.excluded_machine: An excluded machine never becomes the Citadel.
guild.handover_in_progress: A Citadel switch is already under way: wait for it to end.
guild.no_lock: The Guild has no lock at GitHub configured: the switch is not possible yet.
guild.not_active: The machine is no longer in the Guild.
guild.not_online: The machine is not online now.
guild.not_pending: This request was already decided or expired.
guild.not_revealed: The machine has not shown its code yet: wait for the installer to display it.
guild.outside_local_network: This machine is outside the local network: nobody in the Guild reaches it through mestre.local, so it cannot receive the Citadel.
guild.suspended: The Citadel is suspended and takes no changes now.
